apps.localizedDescription:
pziOS runs Project Zomboid (Build 42) on an iPhone or iPad. It is a launcher plus the runtime the game needs: a Java virtual machine built for iOS, an OpenGL-to-Metal graphics stack, and audio and input layers. It runs your own copy of the game; no game assets are included or downloaded.

Free and non-commercial. pziOS is not for sale, not for profit, and not for distribution on any app store. You need to own Project Zomboid. Project Zomboid is a work of The Indie Stone; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Beta (0.9.0). Tested on an iPhone 16 Pro Max (A18 Pro, iOS 27) and an iPad Pro 11-inch 2nd generation (A12Z, iPadOS 26.6.2). Everything else is untested. Expect rough edges.

versions.localizedDescription:
New:

• Mouse sensitivity (Controls → Edit touch layout). A Sensitivity slider sets how fast the on-screen cursor moves when you drag in PAD mode.
• Saved touch layouts. The touch editor has a Saved menu: save the current layout under a name, load one, replace it with the current layout, or delete it.

• Two-finger zoom switch (Settings → Controls). Turns the two-finger scroll that zooms the game on or off.
• ZombieBuddy switch (Developer Tools → Tools). Starts the game with -javaagent:ZombieBuddy.jar for mods that need ZombieBuddy. Put ZombieBuddy.jar in the game folder (Files, pziOS, game); if the file is missing the switch is skipped.

• iOS 17 and 18 Support. On iOS 26 and later pziOS gets its executable memory from the debugger as a mirror-mapped region. On iOS 17 and 18, pziOS now uses the JVM's classic code-cache path instead, chosen automatically and logged as settings: JIT path classic in jvm.log. Please report results on iOS 17 and 18 with your jvm.log.
